scope: Local protocol fixture with real product panel, controller, hook and Android audio bridge; no LAFINA backend or external provider

checks.provisional_gap: PASS: provisional words remained Listening after a >=3 second gap; no automatic final turn
checks.final_replaces_provisional: PASS: one final user persistence callback
checks.synthetic_interruption: PASS: returned to Listening, answer marked interrupted, one interrupted persistence callback
checks.stop: PASS: returned to Listening, native playback false; one user_activity reached fixture
checks.mute_unmute: PASS: recording released, frame counter stayed 2072/2072 over 4 seconds, capture resumed on Unmute
checks.end: PASS: ended UI, no recording or audio focus
checks.background: PASS: stopped with reason, no recording or focus; explicit restart required
checks.socket_failure: PASS: closed message, no recording or focus, no auto restart

local_stop_timing.boundary: controller Stop to native playback-false event; excludes provider detection and network

limitations: No real STT, LLM, ElevenLabs voice or semantic end-of-turn detector in this fixture
Auth/online gates and session API injected; persistence is an in-memory test sink
No physical phone, audibility, echo or Bluetooth check
No new local alarm-to-conversation preemption check; prior reminder call run reported separately
Accessibility dumps became stale; remaining controls verified from fresh screenshots
Approval service usage failure temporarily prevented a final-transcript step; it was retried successfully after the user continued
